items.title: Estimator interface + confidence model
items.context: In core/usage-ledger/estimate.ts (new), define EstimatorKind ('count_tokens'|'local_tokenizer'|'bytes_chars') with a confidence mapping (count_tokens->'high', local_tokenizer->'medium', bytes_chars->'low'), and a TokenEstimator type: an (optionally async) function (model: string, input: string | promptParts) -> { estimatedInputTokens: number, kind: EstimatorKind }. Export the kind->confidence map. Unit-tested: each kind maps to the right confidence.

happy.desc: CONFIDENCE_MAP[count_tokens] === high; WHY: validates the highest-fidelity estimator maps to high confidence
CONFIDENCE_MAP[local_tokenizer] === medium; WHY: validates the mid-tier fallback maps to medium confidence
CONFIDENCE_MAP[bytes_chars] === low; WHY: validates the coarsest offline fallback maps to low confidence
TokenEstimator type accepts an async function (model,input)->{ estimatedInputTokens, kind } and returns a valid result; WHY: confirms the interface works with async estimators as documented

edge.desc: CONFIDENCE_MAP has exactly 3 keys (count_tokens, local_tokenizer, bytes_chars) and no others; WHY: ensures no undocumented EstimatorKind values leak into the confidence model
TokenEstimator sync function (non-async) also works as the type permits optionally async; WHY: ensures sync estimators are not broken by await wrapping

adversarial.desc: Accessing CONFIDENCE_MAP with an invalid key (e.g. unknown_kind) returns undefined, not a fallback confidence; WHY: prevents a typo or injection from silently getting a valid confidence
CONFIDENCE_MAP is frozen/readonly -- mutating it throws or has no effect; WHY: prevents runtime tampering with the confidence model

items.title: Deterministic offline bytes/chars fallback estimator
items.context: Provide a pure, deterministic bytes/chars heuristic estimator (kind='bytes_chars', confidence low) that needs no network and no provider client. Document that it is a coarse guard, NOT tiktoken (tiktoken is OpenAI's and undercounts Claude). Tested: deterministic output for the same input; reasonable monotonicity (more text -> more estimated tokens).

items.title: Estimate selector (count_tokens > local_tokenizer > bytes_chars)
items.context: selectEstimate({model, input, countTokens?: TokenEstimator, localTokenizer?: TokenEstimator}) picks the highest-available estimator in order count_tokens > local_tokenizer > bytes_chars, returns {estimatedInputTokens, kind, confidence, model}. The estimate is bound to the exact model id passed. count_tokens/localTokenizer are injected (optional); when neither is provided, falls back to bytes_chars. Tested: with count_tokens injected -> high; only localTokenizer -> medium; neither -> bytes_chars/low; model id echoed back.

items.title: buildEstimateRecord -> validated prompt-size-estimate record
items.context: buildEstimateRecord(model, estimateResult, correlation{ledgerCallId,attemptId,sequence,supersedesRecordIds}, attribution{storyId|null,phase,agentType}) assembles a usage.source='prompt-size-estimate' record (reuse assemble.ts/record.ts/ids.ts) with estimator{name,version,unit,confidence}, canonical.input = estimatedInputTokens, and output/cacheCreation/cacheRead = null (unknown — nothing generated yet, per the per-dimension null rule). It MUST pass validateUsageLedgerRecord. If the B-253e validator currently rejects a prompt-size-estimate with null output, make the minimal record.ts adjustment so estimates legitimately allow unknown output (estimates are preflight) — with a test — but do NOT relax provider-reported rules. Tested: assembled estimate record validates; source is prompt-size-estimate; estimator fields present.

items.title: Supersedes wiring + estimate-never-final guarantee
items.context: Provide/confirm the helper so a later provider-reported final record lists the preflight estimate's recordId in supersedesRecordIds (buildSupersedes from ids.ts). Confirm via summary.ts that a superseded estimate is excluded from provider-reported totals and that prompt-size-estimate is NEVER counted as final usage (it may appear only in a separate estimate view). Tested: an estimate followed by a superseding provider-reported record -> summary providerReportedTotal counts only the final; estimateSubtotal tracks the estimate separately; no double count.

items.title: Smoke/test suite wired into package.json
items.context: Add packages/main/src/tasks/usage-ledger-estimate-smoke.ts (follow existing *-smoke.ts pattern; ✓/✗, non-zero exit on failure; temp dir, no repo pollution), wired as npm test:usage-ledger-estimate. Cover: confidence mapping; bytes/chars determinism; selector ordering (count_tokens>tokenizer>bytes_chars) with injected stubs; model binding; estimate record validates + is prompt-size-estimate with estimator fields + null output; supersedes interplay with summary (no double count, estimate never final); and an estimate record round-trips through the B-253e writer (opt-in ON, temp dir). Build green; module still imports zero other Lattice modules (grep assert in the smoke).
